conbody.p: The module supports the USB 2.0 High-Speed interface and is compatible with both USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 protocols. It offers a maximum interface rate of up to 480 Mbps and operates only in slave mode. The USB input/output signals are compliant with the USB 2.0 interface specifications.
